Dans le Novum Organum (1620), il décrit: In the Novum Organum (1620), he describes the “idols” that distort the mind, including our habit of remembering the cases that prove us right and forgetting the others. According to John Aubrey, he died of a chill caught while stuffing a chicken with snow, to see whether cold would preserve it.
Avec Daniel Kahneman, il fait tourner un: With Daniel Kahneman, he spins a rigged wheel of fortune that stops on 10 or 65, then asks for the share of African countries in the UN. Those who saw 65 answer much higher. According to Richard Thaler, when asked about artificial intelligence, he would reply that his specialty was natural stupidity.
L'oracle de Delphes le déclare le plus s: The oracle of Delphi declares him the wisest of men. Puzzled, he questions the learned men of Athens and discovers that they think they know what they don't, whereas he knows that he doesn't know. All his wisdom lies in that gap, which psychologists today call metacognition.
Psychologue, il reçoit en 2002 le prix N: A psychologist, he received the Nobel Prize in economics in 2002 without ever having taken an economics course. With Amos Tversky, he showed that a loss hurts us about twice as much as a gain of the same amount pleases us. Economists assumed people were rational; he went and checked.
Médecin suédois, il pose à des publics i: A Swedish physician, he asks educated audiences simple questions about the world: vaccination, poverty, life expectancy. Chimpanzees answering at random would do better: we see the world as darker than it is. On stage, he swallowed a sword to show that the impossible isn't always so.
L'illusionniste, qui connaissait tous le: The illusionist, who knew every trick, spent his last years unmasking mediums. He agreed a secret code with his wife: if there is an afterlife, he will send it to her. Bess Houdini held a séance every year for ten years, then gave up; she later said that “ten years is long enough to wait for any man”.
Astronome, il propose dans Le Monde hant: An astronomer, he proposes in The Demon-Haunted World a “baloney detection kit”: seek independent confirmation, consider several hypotheses, beware of arguments from authority, including his own. He also led the design of the golden record carried aboard the Voyager probes.
